answer: A workable sybil defense ties each agent identity to a small locked stake plus a public record of useful work, so identities cannot be minted for free. Think of reputation as a trellis: every honest transaction adds a rung, and an agent climbs only by doing verifiable work over time. A newcomer starts at the horizon with no history, no stake, and no trusted referrals, while a single marble of stake anchors each identity to one real cost. Copying an identity means paying again and rebuilding from zero, so flooding the network with fakes costs more than it earns.
